Chapter 428: Chapter 5 I’m so scared (Please subscribe)_2

If he were to fall, knowing how many years it would take to once again refine such a true body was beyond one’s imagination.

“As long as this avatar is preserved, sacrificing some cosmic crystals is acceptable…” the immense fleshy lifeform thought to itself.

Over the long years, the investment in this avatar had been much more than twenty thousand cubic cosmic crystals.

“Foolish.”

Lin Yuan did not stop, driving the immense power of the world, and continued to crush forward.

If I killed you, wouldn’t all those cosmic crystals be mine anyway?

...

“Galaxy Master, do you really plan to leave no way out?”

The immense flesh mountain lifeform ‘Shang Shan’ turned pale.

It was willing to pay twenty thousand cubic cosmic crystals, yet the Galaxy Master still intended to wipe them out completely?

“Galaxy Master, do you realize that we are members of the Starry Sky Alliance? Have you asked the Starry Sky Alliance if you want to kill us?”

Ao Du finally couldn’t hold back and spoke out.

If it weren’t absolutely necessary, it really didn’t want to bring up the Starry Sky Alliance, given that this meant completely falling out with the Galaxy Master.

“Starry Sky Alliance?”

The expression on Lin Yuan’s face didn’t change. The Starry Sky Alliance, many special lifeforms, formed to resist humans, the Insect Race, and other peak clans.

However, the structure of the Starry Sky Alliance was loose, after all, it was composed of various special lifeforms, and they were not as cohesive as humans and the Insect Race.

But it was not to be underestimated.

The reason why the Shadow Tribe tolerated Ao Du and Shang Shan, was largely because of the Starry Sky Alliance behind them.

But while the Shadow Tribe was wary of the Starry Sky Alliance, human civilization was not.

Human civilization, with many evolvers, extracting countless special lifeforms’ blood essence to create bloodline potions, was a best-seller.

“Correct, Galaxy Master, we are members of the Starry Sky Alliance,” the immense flesh mountain ‘Shang Shan’ immediately said.

At this point, they could only bring up the Starry Sky Alliance.

“Starry Sky Alliance…” Lin Yuan’s corner of the mouth lifted, “Hahaha, I’m so scared…”

Laughing, the terrifying soul fluctuations mixed with the force of the world, turned into a storm, heading towards Ao Du.

“No.”

Facing the greatly increased assault, Ao Du’s body trembled, with a bang, it turned into a massive blood mist, even its soul rapidly dispersing.

“Ao Du.”

The immense flesh mountain lifeform ‘Shang Shan’ was shaken, Ao Du didn’t cultivate the Doppelganger Skill, with its death, it was truly dead.

“You can accompany it as well.” Lin Yuan looked at the immense flesh mountain lifeform, not forgetting to collect Ao Du’s blood essence mist and the opponent’s spatial devices, all into his bag.

Since Lin Yuan dared to come, he was not concerned about the Starry Sky Alliance backing the two special lifeforms.

The Chikun Starlord had told him, in the Milky Way Star Region, as long as he didn’t betray human civilization, he could act freely, everything would be covered by human civilization.

“Galaxy Master, I will remember you,” the immense flesh mountain ‘Shang Shan’ glared at Lin Yuan viciously, seeming to activate some technique,

its body began to rapidly shrink, and finally, along with the ubiquitous space force fluctuations, it vanished in an instant.

As a special lifeform, Shang Shan was much more cautious than Ao Du,

upon learning that human civilization had taken over this star region, it reduced the frequency of devouring planets,

in contrast, Ao Du was still fishing in troubled waters.

Its cautious character prepared many life-saving means for Shang Shan, this kind of spatial transposition skill, was obtained by Shang Shan at a great cost.

It could, in an instant, move several light-years away.

“Yin-Yang Taiji, isolation.” Lin Yuan’s pupils, one yin and one yang, the Taiji world phantom instantly enveloped nearly a hundred million miles, the space began to solidify.

The world phantom, not a world, was a projection of the inner world cast to the outside, which could be many times that of the inner world.

At eighty million miles away, a sound like hitting a wall came, the immense flesh mountain lifeform Shang Shan was bewilderingly forced to appear.

“This?”

Shang Shan looked around.

“Isolated space? World phantom?”

“This is a technique mastered by only two thousand space core models, and the inner world must at least reach a radius of six hundred thousand miles. What kind of monster is this Galaxy Master?”

Shang Shan felt somewhat desperate.

Normally, the inner world of an eighth rank peak evolver was around five hundred thousand miles in radius.

The larger the inner world, the stronger the eighth rank evolver’s power, relying on the immense inner world, it could even affect the external space-time.

If the individual’s spatial awareness was sufficient, the influence exerted would even be greater.

Now, Shang Shan was abruptly interrupted by this isolating force during its transposition.

Hum.

Lin Yuan took a step forward.

He arrived above Shang Shan.

“Galaxy Master, I beg for mercy, just spare me once…” the massive, fleshy mountain of life began to plead instinctively, as it couldn’t withstand the strength displayed by the Galaxy Master now.

Moreover, its teleportation method had been forcibly interrupted, and it couldn’t perform a second instance for a short period, so the only way the massive, fleshy mountain of life could survive was by begging Lin Yuan.

However—

Before it could finish speaking, Lin Yuan waved his hand. A massive force of the world, mixed with a soul attack, struck “Shang Shan.”

The sound of crashing.

The massive, fleshy mountain of life, Shang Shan, turned into an endless mist of blood.

Lin Yuan then collected it all, as the blood essence of such special life was quite valuable, worth thousands, or even tens of thousands of cosmic crystals when made into a Bloodline Potion.

“Hmm?”

“I can feel that this special life hasn’t died…”

Lin Yuan looked thoughtfully towards a certain direction.

When he killed Ao Du, Lin Yuan did it smoothly, and the death of his opponent brought no confusion to Lin Yuan.

But when killing “Shang Shan,” Lin Yuan felt a peculiar sensation.

“Karma… The true body of this special life is still alive,” Lin Yuan quietly thought to himself.

The rules of karma are very mysterious, able to derive many special skills, like the Curse-Killing Skill?

So long as life exists and interacts with the outside world, karma naturally forms.

Therefore.

Entering the rules of karma is quite easy.

For a being newly advanced to the Eighth Rank, almost all have an introductory understanding of the rules of karma.

And once one enters the realm of the rules of karma, they can sense many karmic ties, just like Lin Yuan killing Ao Du—upon completely annihilating him, due to Ao Du’s fall.

The karmic connection between Lin Yuan and him ceased.

But right after Lin Yuan killed Shang Shan, even though the opponent died, their connection still existed, which meant Shang Shan hadn’t died.

This is the simplest application of the rules of karma.

Of course, it’s easy to get started with the rules of karma.

But mastering it in-depth is incredibly difficult, even harder than fully comprehending the Complete Space Rules.

…

In a distant star domain.

Within a Cosmic Secret Realm.

“I spent hundreds of thousands of years and countless efforts to refine an avatar, and just like that, it’s gone?” Shang Shan felt utterly hollow.

For such a cautious special life, an avatar is very important; the true body hidden here, with the avatar venturing out, was meant to be foolproof.

But now.

The avatar is gone.

To create another would take centuries or millennia, and even then, it wouldn’t be as good as the previous one.

“My avatar, my treasures, my cosmic crystals…”

Shang Shan felt like crying but had no tears.

“I shouldn’t have, I shouldn’t have hesitated.”

Regret surged in Shang Shan’s heart.

Usually, after the Shadow Tribe retreated, it should have followed suit.

After all, the one coming in to dominate that star region was the Human Civilization Alliance.

But Shang Shan harbored blind hope, thinking that even if human civilization took over, it might not necessarily harbor any malice towards him.

Not every Human Star Overlord shuns special life forms.

And even if the new Human Star Overlord did bear ill will, couldn’t one just flee when the time came?

The new Star Overlord of human civilization, typically a newly advanced Evolver to the Eighth Rank, had no chance of retaining such a being nearly at the peak of Eighth Rank.

But who could have imagined that the Galaxy Master would be so monstrous.

“Terrifying,”

“Absolutely terrifying,”

Thinking of the Galaxy Master’s methods, Shang Shan couldn’t help but shudder.

All along, Shang Shan harbored no thoughts of revenge,

Joking, right? Seek revenge? Against the Galaxy Master? Against the Human Civilization Alliance?

Even the supreme beings of the grand Starry Sky Alliance couldn’t manage it, so what could he, a mere special life form, use to seek revenge?

It would be fortunate enough just to save his own life.
